questions.title: Create a Student Class
questions.description: Write a Java program that defines a Student class with name and age fields, and a display() method. Create a Student object with name 'John' and age 20, then display their info.
hints: Class fields: String name, int age

questions.title: Constructor Overloading
questions.description: Write a Rectangle class with width and height fields. Create two constructors: a default constructor that sets both to 1, and a parameterized constructor. Create two rectangles and calculate their areas.

questions.title: Encapsulation Practice
questions.description: Write a BankAccount class with a private balance field. Implement public getter, deposit(), and withdraw() methods. The withdraw should prevent negative balance. Start with balance 1000, deposit 500, withdraw 200, then display balance.
hints: Return boolean from withdraw to indicate success

questions.title: Static Counter
questions.description: Write a Counter class that tracks how many instances have been created using a static variable. Each object should have its own ID (1, 2, 3...). Create 3 counters and display each ID and total count.
constraints: Use static variable for total count
Each object has unique instance ID
Static method to get total count

examples.output:
Counter 1 ID: 1
Counter 2 ID: 2
Counter 3 ID: 3
Total instances: 3

questions.title: Object Array
questions.description: Write a Book class with title and price fields. Create an array of 3 books, then write code to find and display the most expensive book.
constraints: Book class with title and price

examples.output:
Books: Java($45), Python($35), C++($50)
Most expensive: C++ - $50

hints: Loop through to find max price
Track both max price and book reference
